name: Reduce the bandwidth-bound single-token BF16 output projection
hypothesis: A lossless auxiliary BF16 encoding reduces M=1 output-head weight traffic enough to produce material end-to-end decode savings.
derivation: The prior profile measured about 2.105 ms of lm_head work per decode token; across 64 generated tokens this is about 134.72 ms of the 344.44 ms request latency.

evidence.claim: Prior same-GPU profiling and paired model evidence establish a material lm_head opportunity.

production_impact_gate.derivation: With 39.11% of the frozen request assigned to the output head, even a finite 3.878x component ceiling permits about 1.409x end-to-end speedup.

evidence.claim: Frozen request latency and component attribution used by the Amdahl gate.
